content: Inii weɗ uup raak njiriñ ngaŋ ini ɓoo na woye jen : Weɗ ne ɓoo raakiɗ Seeƴkiɗoh yakak mand ɗaa. A yaa ɓooffa ŋ Eel ca, ŋ ñaahmaŋ ɓoofohaanaŋ Kooh yi buur.
A yaa panguk ŋ Ɗiska Hooliɗa, weɗ ɗiipa keeh-keeha, Kahnaŋ Kooh, wa fu inah ne a Heɗi tufkiɗa, ɓo' haɓiɗɗaa.
Seeƴkiɗoh yakak nu fu hot ɗah, a tufkiɗu ne a eɗee Kooh onoh ci, na seeƴuk ci. Kon Seeƴkiɗohiŋ ɓoo joyeen nam raak ini a eɗohan.
A nikee ŋ kehƴi ɗah, a heeɗi sah nike seeƴkiɗoh, laam raakiɗ seeƴkiɗoh ci nik ndii, ɓi na eɗee Kooh onoh ci findi waasiŋMusaa nakohoha.

Ɓeɗ ɓeem, ɓa na pangkiɗe Kooh ŋ ɗisik wi fu inah ne wa ñaamaariŋ in ca keeh-keeh ca nik ŋ ɗafka. Wa saangniŋ ca rek. Findi Fiis ci woyoha, wa Musaa hee haɓɗe ɗiipa nikee Kahan Kooh, Kooh woytoh ɗe woytoh an : « Marka, te fu haɓiɗa jen, findi wa fu teeɓsee ŋ ɗafuk tangoori. »

Ɗiski wa nik, Yeesu a yi eɗu ne a nik ŋ harmban ɓooɓi na Kooh ne a tiindiɗ ambtiɗoh as, wi deguk ŋ gapoh as. Findi Ambtiɗohi Asi uupoh wa koc, te findi gapoh ci as ci namoh uup ca koc, pangkiŋ ɗe uupoh fuuf wiŋ seeƴkiɗoh ci koc ɗaa.
Ŋ Ambtiɗoha Koc, woyaah raakeeɗi nga ɗah, kon wa heeɗi etohisse ne Ambtiɗohi Kanakɗoh tufkiɗasse.
Waaye Kooh raak raak woyaah nga, findi wa woyohu ŋ Fiis ci ne :

content.text: « A Heɗi woo ne :
“ Inhaat ne : Mbeh cii hayeeɗa,
ŋ hey tufkiɗe ambtiɗoh as na cuuɓiŋ Israayel,
na wiŋ Yudaa
Wa mandanɗi na ambtiɗohi ŋ tufkiɗee na caac caŋ ɓa,
wa ŋ amb ɓa ŋ yaah
ne ŋ puliɗ ɓa Misra.
Laam ɓa ambɗi Ambtiɗohi,
weɗ tah ŋ liiɓisɗi nga ɓa.
Mi yi Heɗi, ñam woo wa.
Ambtiɗohii weɗ maa hee tufkiɗe na cuuɓiŋ Israayel
ŋ finho mbeh ceem :
- Mi yi Heɗi, ñam woo wa -
Ŋ hey ɓeke nakoh ciŋ ngo ŋ liiɓ ciŋ ɓa,
ŋ fiis ca ŋ ɗooƴ keeñ ciŋ ɓa ;
ŋ nik Koohiŋ ɓa, ɓa nik ɓooɓiŋ ngo.
Ali ɓo' jangɗissanɗi gentohiŋ ɗe wala ɓaah ce,
a woyee ɗe ne : ‘Inha Heɗi.’
Ɓooɓi jen hey yo inhe,
ini amboh ŋ yi uup ƴissuut po ŋ yi uup yak.
Laam ŋ hey ɓa ɗaase kiyurhaaɗiikiŋ ɓa,
ŋ naandsukissanɗi bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa. ” »

content: Kon Kooh woyee woo ambtiɗoh as ɗah, raakee ɗe kiisiɗ kiisiɗ wa koc. In nu maañ po wa yakakee ɗah, wa usisɗi ŋ coot.

footnotes.text: Israayel na Yudaa : Yudaa, a kuɓu Yaŋhooɓa yi Kooh teek Israayel, kon cuuɓiŋ Yudaa ɓaah ngaŋ cuuɓiŋ Israayel. Waaye, wa buur Suleymaan kaan, kur kaŋ Israayel saɓsukohha kanak. Ɓaka nikee ŋ yaah-sing ne fu yurhiɗkoh pulohaaɗ-noh ɗah, rissa na tiikiŋ Israayel, ɓaki tas teekuusa Yudaa (1 Buur ci 12:1-24; 2 Nguur ci 10:1–11:4).
